scope: Diagnostic normal-camera pickup samples, controlled departure entropy through formal entry. Static full-body route to selected searchable node (first safe by default; QA_NODE_ID explicit when set). Ordinary keyboard input; no health, time, loot, visibility or position writes. Not a natural first-time discovery or full expedition.

controlledDeparture.method: One departure entropy value supplied before normal Shift+Enter; no gameplay position, clock, save or reward edits
